message.content:
This appears to come from a CBP ruling on the OFP Boyles 15 Console Assembly, a control console for a drill rig. The likely candidates are:

- 8431.43 covers parts suitable for use solely or principally with boring or sinking machinery of 8430.41 or 8430.49. Within it, 8431.43.80 is "Other" and 8431.43.8090 is likely the statistical suffix.
- 8537.10 covers control panels for voltage up to 1,000 V. This is electrical, and the console here is hydraulic, so it does not fit.
- 8481.80 covers valve manifolds.

The console is hydraulic with gauges, levers, and a valve bank, and is built for drilling. I recall CBP ruling N-series classifying such an item in 8431.43.8090 as parts of drilling machinery. One alternative is 8413 for hydraulic parts, but 8431 fits better for a part dedicated to drilling machinery.

Within 8431.43, the subheadings are 8431.43.20 (parts of offshore drilling or production platforms), 8431.43.40 (parts of boring or sinking machinery of 8430.41, 8430.49 — including drill bits) and 8431.43.80 (other). I'll go with 8431.43.8000.

```json
{"hts_code": "8431.43.8000", "reason": "The hydraulic control console with valve bank is identifiable as a part solely or principally used with boring/drilling machinery of heading 8430, so it falls in 8431.43 as an other part."}
```
